lead: Run `php -m` before designing an oracle around an extension's function.
body: The Windows `php` has no `mbstring`, so every `mb_*` dies with *"Call to undefined function"*, and neither leg has `gmp`, so `Core\Math::gcd`/`lcm` have no callable twin; `bcmath` is on both. Write the oracle as a second implementation in PHP, as `Core\Path::normalize` does (`gaps.py --differential` looks for the Novis member in `tests/differential/`, not the twin).
